paths.name: @douyinfe/semi-ui
paths.message: Use @douyinfe/semi-ui-19. Importing both ships two copies of the component library and two provider trees, so the second one silently ignores the locale.

patterns.message: The frontend must not import from lib/. That code is server-side and may grow a Node built-in at any time, which breaks the Vite build far from the cause. Copy what you need into ui/src instead - see ui/src/services/finance/ for the pattern.
